name: video-prompt-builder
description: Build clean keyframes and continuity-safe prompts for short AI video clips - single shots, multi-clip sequences, and golden-hour dreamscapes.

interface.longDescription: Generate production-ready prompts for short AI video clips. Build a clean still keyframe as a visual anchor, write motion-only prompts that preserve characters, framing, environment, and lighting, plan multi-clip sequences that cut together without drift, and apply a golden-hour dreamscape aesthetic. Supports Veo, Wan, Seedance, and similar image-to-video workflows.
defaultPrompt: Build a short AI video prompt from my scene or keyframe. Preserve visual continuity and describe motion clearly.
Create a clean keyframe to use as the visual anchor for my clip.
Plan a four-clip sequence that cuts together without visual drift.
Give this scene a golden-hour dreamscape look with warm moon clusters and sky-reaching massifs.
